problem.scope: Extend L010 playback with regional CDN selection, origin shields and region-failure policy. Compare multi-CDN steering and bounded peer-assisted regional delivery. Segment identity/integrity and playback deadline remain explicit.

[Backoff](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exponential_backoff) spaces repeated attempts so failures do not create a burst of extra traffic.
